claims.summary: The marker scanner is non-destructive and distinguishes raw marker bytes from referenced markers: a referenced marker is preserved in `remainder`, an un-referenced marker is stripped (cites scan_known_model_control_markers L114, reference_syntax L49).
claims.disposition: Verified from complete source (SHA 902a0358). scan_known_model_control_markers L114-144 copies all non-marker bytes byte-exact and pushes a marker token into `remainder` only when reference_syntax (L49) is Some (delimiter or explicit relation); otherwise the marker bytes are dropped. Cited lines L114/L49 are accurate.

claims.summary: Snag: first_word_after (L89) only inspects the first word after the marker end, so a relational verb preceded by an adverb (Test 1: '[MARKER] actually serves as') is missed and the marker is not preserved.
claims.disposition: Grounded and pinned. first_word_after L89-96 returns only the first alphanumeric-trimmed word: 'actually' displaces 'serves', so followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation is false and a bare marker is stripped. Correction preserved (not domesticated): her bracketed [MARKER] is preserved by the delimiter path (Grouped), so the snag manifests only for a bare marker. New regression control_marker_cleanup_does_not_skip_adverb_before_relation_word pins current behavior; grammar not widened.

claims.summary: Test 2: verify exact_reference_delimiter_syntax reports delimiter_depth for a nested quote structure ("'[MARKER]'") and respects MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH (L151).
claims.disposition: Mechanism already covered by reports_exact_three/four_level_delimiter_depth and bounds_homogeneous_square_bracket_stack_beyond_max_depth (L151 MAX=4 saturates only the reported depth). Her literal ASCII mix "'[MARKER]'" (double-quote/single-quote/bracket, no prose between) was untested; new regression control_marker_cleanup_reports_mixed_ascii_quote_bracket_stack_depth_three pins context=grouped (innermost bracket), depth 3, preserved byte-exact.

claims.summary: Suggested Next: refine first_word_after / followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation to allow optional adverbs or skip-logic so relations survive natural-language variance.
claims.disposition: Not implemented; preserved as a deliberate authority boundary. Widening the relation detector to skip adverbs changes which markers survive in Astrid's visible output (a being-facing model-behavior change) and broadens production grammar, the same boundary held for introspection_astrid_llm_1786319270. Her concern is retained, not dismissed; current behavior is pinned by the new regression instead of a silent grammar change.
